recipe.visualDefinition: A candid-style portrait of a woman in the driver's seat of a vintage car, captured with the warm, grainy texture of 1970s film. The scene is set against a blurred urban background featuring a yellow taxi, with a focus on jewelry, a single white rose, and bold, layered typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered within the car interior frame
Warm brown and ochre tones contrasted by magenta typography
Soft focus background vs. sharp foreground details like jewelry
Diagonal lines of the car window and steering wheel leading to the subject
coreInvariants: Analog film grain and slight motion blur
Warm, desaturated color palette with high-saturation accents

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot of a woman, centered horizontally, leaning slightly to the right, occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large pendant necklace.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top-center typography down to the subject's face, following the arms to the steering wheel and the white rose.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The blurred street scene visible through the car windows provides atmospheric negative space.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and earthy ochres in the clothing and car interior.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted yellow from the background taxi and the white of the rose.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant magenta and purple used for the primary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-to-medium saturation across the image with high-value highlights on jewelry and the rose.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a thick, connected script with rounded terminals
Secondary text uses a wide, extended sans-serif with high tracking
Heavy outer stroke/inline effect on the script
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders are shortened to maintain a compact horizontal block
Interlocking characters in the script to create a singular graphic unit
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a fluid, heavy script and a rigid, wide-tracked sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide-tracked, technical look of the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A 1970s film-style photograph of a woman sitting in a vintage car. She wears a brown top and heavy jewelry. A white rose is held near the steering wheel. In the background, a blurred yellow taxi is visible on a city street. Warm, grainy, analog aesthetic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a wide-tracked sans-serif subtitle in all caps at the top center. Below it, add a large, bold magenta script title with a thick dark purple outline.

verificationChecks: Is the film grain visible and authentic?
Does the magenta text have a thick, contrasting outline?
Is the subtitle text extremely wide-tracked?
Is the color palette dominated by warm browns and yellows?

adjustableVariables: Blur level of the background taxi
mustRedesign: Clean vector lines in the background
postGenerationChecks: Check for analog artifacts like light leaks or soft edges
Ensure the script text feels integrated but prominent
Verify the jewelry has a realistic metallic sheen
Confirm the white rose acts as a high-value focal point
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Film Portrait + Urban Backdrop + Layered Script Typography
